item.description: In Oracle Database 19c, when a tempfile is added on the primary database, it is not automatically created on the physical standby database. item.description: The problem If you've run any LLM agent for 30+ minutes, you've seen this: the agent follows its system prompt perfectly at the start, then gradually drifts.
